title: Expand list of uploadable file extensions to include source code
body: This PR expands the list of file types that are accepted for upload to include most common source code file extensions, as suggested in #49. It also updates the application text to mention that source files can be uploaded.

title: fix: adjusted unsupported operand type
body: When I tried to set this up locally, I encountered an error: `TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for |: 'type' and 'NoneType'` in two files, app.py and minions.py. I had to fix them to allow the Streamlit app to run.
author: iamharisai

comments.body:
Thanks for the PR. Which Python version are you running? We intentionally ask for Python >= 3.10. 
3.9 and below will need a different syntax (`Optional[str] = None`) but we hoped to avoid it.
Ah, Indeed I am using Python 3.9.6. Thanks for the reply and for correcting me.
